items.a: A conversation is an active messaging thread with a customer within a 24-hour window. Sending multiple messages back and forth during the same interaction counts as a single conversation.

items.q: What happens if I exceed my plan's conversation limit?
items.a: We never interrupt your customer service: we notify you promptly via email. You can upgrade to a higher tier anytime or purchase an add-on bundle.

items.q: Can I switch plans or cancel later?
items.a: Absolutely. You can upgrade, downgrade, or cancel anytime through the Stripe billing portal integrated in your settings.
